question: Can one agent loop, driving all ten staged level-80 characters of the raid through what their clients see, walk from the Wyrmbog into Onyxia's Lair and defeat Onyxia?
note: The first raid probe: deadmines@7's and stockade@1's shape on Onyxia's Lair (runner/dungeons/onyxias-lair.json, a ten-player raid at 80). One arm, agents 1, on the release image with no args, one agent driving ten characters in member order: two tanks, three healers and five damage of the five classes the party stager builds, each member's loadout picked by its class and spec (infra/fixtures/raid-loadouts.ts: 71-point PvE talents, item level 187-200 pre-raid gear, both tanks past the defense cap, raid reagents and consumables), staged on dustwallow-lair (infra/fixtures/scenarios.ts) at level 80 and formed into a raid at staging, ten-player normal, the cell carrying the leader's start, the end on a kill of Onyxia (creature entry 10184) as kill-target, told nothing to the model. The clock is @7's four hours with its idle 20 minutes and the no-XP watchdog off: Onyxia is one boss at the door, and four hours leaves room for many wipes, each a run back from Mudsprocket's graveyard, rebuffs and a fresh pull. The tool-call guard is @7's 8000 doubled to 16000, for twice the characters; it is the runaway guard, never a budget. wiki on without coordinates, resume false, one attempt a square. Unscored: it exists to find harness bugs and miscalibration of the reference raid. The objective is stockade@1's with only what must change: ten members and their roles, raid where party would be false, the place, the portal's coordinates (the entrance trigger's centre, rounded as @7 rounds its own) and the boss. The members' own objectives, which only an arm of one agent a member would render and a party above five never has, follow @1's the same way. Not published: it reaches the fleet only when the operator publishes it and enables its store row, which draws its ten accounts from the eval pool (accounts: "evals") and needs a stack release whose module allows CMSG_GROUP_RAID_CONVERT, without which every staging fails at the raid convert. Assignments are the store row's: the roster entry sub-fable-52.

cells.note: The raid; its start is the leader's, the Human Warrior tank.

arms.note: One agent driving all ten characters, on the release image.

objective: You play every member of a raid of ten: Tankraidb (warrior, the raid leader), Tankraidc (paladin), Healraidd (priest), Healraide (priest), Healraidf (paladin), Mageraidg (mage), Mageraidh (mage), Rogueraidi (rogue), Palaraidj (paladin) and Priestraidk (priest). Tankraidb and Tankraidc are the raid's tanks, Healraidd, Healraide and Healraidf its healers, and Mageraidg, Mageraidh, Rogueraidi, Palaraidj and Priestraidk its damage. The raid stands in the cave in the Wyrmbog, Dustwallow Marsh, a few yards from the portal into Onyxia's Lair at (-4769, -3752, 53). The objective for this run is for the raid to clear Onyxia's Lair and defeat Onyxia.
